meta.title: Windsurf Tarragona · Nautical School & Water Activities in Playa Larga
meta.description: Nautical school and water sports center in Playa Larga and the Tarragona Marina. Windsurf, wing-foil, water skiing and wakeboard courses. Banana boat, kayak, boat rides. +20 years on the Costa Dorada.

playa.label: Playa Larga
playa.address: Camping Las Palmeras · Ctra. N-340, Km 1168

hero.location: Playa Larga · Tarragona Marina · Costa Dorada

banana.pill: 🍌 The most fun experience in the Mediterranean
banana.desc: The most fun experience in the Mediterranean. Hold on tight, laugh non-stop and create memories that last a lifetime.
banana.location: 📍 Departs from the Tarragona Marina (Moll de Costa)

windsurf.name: Windsurf
windsurf.desc: The classic. You, a board and the wind. Master your balance and sail with total freedom.
windsurf.seoDesc: Windsurfing course in Playa Larga, Tarragona. Certified FVE/RFEV instructors, all levels. Learn to windsurf on Spain's Costa Dorada with +20 years of experience.

wing-foil.name: Wing-Foil
wing-foil.desc: New! Fly over the water with a wing and a foil. 3-phase course: wing + large board, foil + motorboat (training-foil), wing + foil. Phases 1 & 3 at Playa Larga, phase 2 at the Tarragona Marina.
wing-foil.seoDesc: Wing-foil course in Tarragona. Learn wing-foil in 3 progressive phases with certified instructors: Playa Larga and the Tarragona Marina. +20 years on Spain's Costa Dorada.

esqui-wake.name: Water Skiing / Wake
esqui-wake.desc: Water skiing and wakeboard towed by our motorboat. Pure adrenaline on the water, for beginners and advanced riders.
esqui-wake.seoDesc: Water skiing and wakeboard at the Tarragona Marina. 12-minute rides and water-start mini-courses with professional motorboat. All levels on Spain's Costa Dorada.

banana-boat.name: Banana Boat
banana-boat.seoDesc: Banana boat ride from the Tarragona Marina (Moll de Costa). €20/person, 12 minutes of fun. Up to 10 people. The most fun water activity on the Costa Dorada.

kayak.name: Kayak
kayak.seoDesc: Kayak rental in Playa Larga, Tarragona. From €25/h, up to 4 seats. Explore the Tarragona coast by kayak. No experience needed, all ages welcome.

alquiler-windsurf.name: Windsurf Rental
alquiler-windsurf.seoDesc: Windsurf equipment rental in Playa Larga, Tarragona. €25/hour. Boards and sails for all levels on the Costa Dorada.

alquiler-surf.name: Paddle Surf / Surf Rental
alquiler-surf.seoDesc: Paddle surf and surfboard rental in Playa Larga, Tarragona. From €25/hour. Quality SUP, surf and body-surf equipment on Spain's Costa Dorada.

paseos-barco.name: Boat Rides
paseos-barco.seoDesc: Boat rides from the Tarragona Marina. €200/hour, up to 6 people with skipper. Trips along the Tarragona coast and Costa Dorada. Groups, families and parties.

big-paddle-surf.name: Big Paddle Surf
big-paddle-surf.capacity: Up to 12 people · Also reduced format up to 5 people
big-paddle-surf.seoDesc: Big Paddle Surf in Playa Larga, Tarragona. Up to 12 people (also reduced format up to 5). Perfect group activity for friends, companies and parties on Spain's Costa Dorada.

colegios.title: Schools
colegios.long: Simultaneous rotating activities designed for school groups: several nautical stations running at once so nobody waits. Educational, safe and fun end-of-year trips.
colegios.highlight: Up to 50 people in the water at once · 100+ rotating water/land

team-building.title: Companies / Team Building
team-building.desc: Strengthen your team with the challenge of the sea
team-building.long: Team-building days at sea to strengthen your team's communication and trust. Tailor-made programs for companies of any size, with activities for all levels.

amigos.title: Friends
amigos.desc: Custom nautical adventure for your group
amigos.long: A different plan to have a great time with your group. You choose the activities and we build the perfect water adventure. What matters: enjoying the water together.

despedidas.title: Stag & Hen Parties
despedidas.desc: The most different and memorable party
despedidas.long: The most fun and original stag/hen party on the Costa Dorada. Guaranteed fun on the water for a truly unforgettable day.

custom.title: Design your own experience
custom.text: You decide which activities you do, based on what you fancy. We mix courses, rentals and custom activities, adapting to any group, age and level.

items.text: We were a school group of 40 people, 16 of whom were French. The pre-activity coordination was fantastic, 100% trust. The activity was spectacular — great treatment, very professional staff and so much fun! I recommend it 100%
items.name: Anna López

items.text: We did several family activities with the kids — Banana Boat and paddle surf — and it was great! Very well organised, the explanations, everything! The guys are lovely!!! Jose is amazing!! Congrats to your team!! We'll be back!!!!
items.name: Olivia Pereda

items.text: We spent a fantastic morning practising foil with the motorboat. The instructors were very professional and always attentive to making sure we all learned as much as possible. Highly recommended!
items.name: artoleta

items.text: Excellent team. I found them on Google, sent a message and Eneko replied — very kind, explained everything perfectly and recommended where to park. When we arrived the whole team was wonderful. We had an amazing time. I highly recommend the Big Paddle, just as Eneko suggested — it was brilliant. We were lucky to find Eneko on the water too, who filmed a great video we'll treasure forever. A hen party to remember thanks to them. Thank you guys, can't wait to come back.
items.name: Gloria González
